profile: Game engine programmer with 7 years of experience in C++, Unreal Engine and Unity, focused on performance profiling, optimization tooling and engine plugins. Built Unity and Unreal Engine plugins and a plug-and-play optimization toolset for an upcoming Samsung flagship device, profiled games for performance bottlenecks with RenderDoc and Nsight Graphics, and shipped mobile and Apple Vision Pro work. Experienced in OpenGL and Vulkan, and in explaining complex technical topics to cross-functional teams.

experience.headline: Unity and Unreal optimization plugins and tooling for an upcoming Samsung flagship. A binary IPC protocol cut bandwidth by 32%, and I co-authored a patent application.

impact.label: less inter-process bandwidth after replacing JSON with a binary protocol
application co-authored on rendering performance techniques

experience.summary: Optimization tooling and engine plugins for an unannounced project.
points: Developed high-performance Unity and Unreal Engine plugins that communicate with internal optimization tools.
Replaced JSON with a compact binary protocol, cutting inter-process communication bandwidth by about 32%.
Reviewed profiling reports for games moved from PC to mobile and found gaps, such as a major studio's mobile engine missing frustum culling.
Co-authored a patent application on novel techniques for improving rendering performance.
Built a plug-and-play performance optimization toolset selected for integration into an upcoming Samsung flagship device.

experience.headline: Unreal Engine 5 rendering and UI for Apple Vision Pro. Passing ASTC textures to the native visionOS renderer cut VRAM use by 40%.

impact.label: less VRAM by passing ASTC-compressed textures to the native visionOS renderer
source changes so UMG UIs work with Vision Pro eye-gaze and pinch

experience.summary: Unreal Engine 5 rendering and UI for Apple Vision Pro.
points: Led the investigation of alpha holdout blending in UE5 on Apple Vision Pro, using RenderDoc to find mobile rendering pipeline limits for transparent elements in mixed reality.
Found that multi-pass transparency, which blends separate opaque and translucent buffers, worked on Windows and Mac but was unsupported on visionOS, iOS and Android.
Built a pipeline that passes ASTC-compressed textures from Unreal Engine to the native visionOS renderer, cutting VRAM use by 40%.
Modified Unreal Engine source so UMG designs are replicated in the native UI framework, enabling Vision Pro eye-gaze and pinch input.
Implemented face-lock behaviour for RealityKit entities using its ECS.

experience.headline: A C++ engine with Lua scripting and its own input, debugger and profiler modules, plus gameplay systems for an Android multiplayer RTS in Unreal.

impact.label: engine modules built in C++: input, debugger and profiler
on Unreal and C++ teams, onboarding engineers and technical artists

experience.summary: Engine and gameplay programming across three projects, moving from Unity to Unreal Engine and C++.

Integrated Lua scripting so gameplay logic can drive engine modules.
Built three engine modules: input, debugger and profiler.
Used the abstract factory pattern to support each target API and platform.

points: Implemented the gameplay framework and engine-side systems for movement, collision and game state in Unreal Engine and C++.
Worked on gameplay systems, UI and shaders for an Android multiplayer title.
Built an Unreal plugin with UPL to integrate an ad SDK, designed so another SDK can be swapped in with minimal code changes.
Designed the architecture to decouple UI from gameplay logic.

points: Built an Unreal Engine 4 endless runner with multithreaded background loading and object pooling for runtime performance.

testimonials.name: Santosh Shedbalkar
testimonials.title: Head of Engineering, 1518 Studios, Inc
testimonials.relation: Managed Pranav for about 2.5 years at Pole To Win
testimonials.pull: He quickly became a core part of the development team. He took on multiple responsibilities on the project including on-boarding and mentoring multiple engineers and TechArtists who were unfamiliar with working on Unreal Engine.
quote: I had the good fortune of working with Pranav for about 2.5 years as his Manager at PTW. He joined as a Junior Unity developer but when presented with an opportunity to learn and work with Unreal Engine, he took it and put in the hard work to learn it with very little guidance. He successfully delivered the trial solo game that he worked on with Unreal and the game looked and played fantastic. Based on the high quality of the game, he was put on a multiplayer mobile game using Unreal and C++ and he quickly became a core part of the development team. He took on multiple responsibilities on the project including on-boarding and mentoring multiple engineers and TechArtists who were unfamiliar with working on Unreal Engine. Because of his friendly demeanour, patience, and willingness to help out, many team members felt quite comfortable approaching him for any kind of technical issues and he helped them the best way he could.

He left us to pursue higher studies in Game development, with the help of which, I have no doubt that he will become an even better game developer. He possesses very good written and spoken communication skills and is always very professional in his conduct. He is a very curious person by nature and strives to understand/learn new things constantly. I definitely recommend him for any Game Developer position.
